title: CPSC, Fisher-Price Announce Recall of Scooters and Mini Bikes
summary: The motor control circuits can malfunction, causing the scooters and mini bikes to continue to run after the power or throttle button is released, posing a risk of injury to children. Units: About 30,000 Lightning PAC Scooters, and about 55,000 MX3 Mini Bikes.

title: CPSC, Polardreams International Ltd. Announce Recall of Candle Gift Sets
summary: The candle gift set can exhibit a larger-than-normal flame height as the tealight candle burns to the end, posing a potential fire hazard. Units: 50,600.

title: CPSC, Target Corporation Announce Recall of Multicolored Sidewalk Chalk
summary: The multicolored sidewalk chalk contains high levels of lead, posing a risk of poisoning to young children. The Wisconsin Department of Health tested the chalk and identified the lead in the chalk. Units: 26,000 packages.

title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Inc. Announce Recall of ATVs
summary: Damage to the fuel tank grommet can cause a fuel leak, posing a serious fire hazard to consumers. Units: 14,000.

title: CPSC, Advantage Publishers Group Announce Recall of Children's Activity Books
summary: The hub of the pink dial embedded in the inside back cover can come off during use in some of these books, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 5,300.

title: CPSC, BRIO® Corp. Announce Recall of Toy Drums
summary: The three rubber feet, which are screwed into the bottom of the drum, could be removed in some cases, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: 2,100.

title: CPSC, The Metal Ware Corp. Announce Recall of Deep Fryer Covers
summary: The mesh filter in the cover of the deep fryer can allow moisture to build in the oil reservoir, causing the oil reservoir to boil over during or shortly after use. This poses a burn hazard to consumers. Units: 47,000.

title: CPSC, American Greetings Corp. Announce Recall of Cloth Santa Decorations Sold at Wal-Mart
summary: The beaded nose on the cloth Santa decoration could detach, posing an aspiration hazard to young children. Units: 500.

title: CPSC, American Greetings Corp. Announce Recall of Crazy Bounce Balls
summary: The balls could break apart, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: 17,000.

title: CPSC, American Greetings Corp. Announce Recall of Zipper Pulls
summary: The product could separate and detach from the zipper, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: 122,700.

title: CPSC, Meijer Inc. Announce Recall of Children's Jackets
summary: These jackets have hood drawstrings. Children can get entangled and strangled in the drawstrings that catch on objects, including playground equipment, fences and tree branches. Units: About 7,500.

title: CPSC, The May Department Stores Co. Announce Recall of Girls' Hooded Fleece Jackets
summary: The zipper pull could detach from these jackets, posing a possible choking hazard to young children. Units: 57,660.

title: CPSC, Toys "R" Us, Inc. Announce Recall of Solid-colored and Multi-colored Sidewalk Chalk
summary: The multi-colored and solid-colored sidewalk chalk contains high levels of lead, posing a risk of poisoning to young children. Units: 50,000 packages.

title: CPSC, Merit Furniture Distributors Announce Recall of Bunk Beds
summary: The bunk beds have openings between the guardrails and in the end structures that are too large. A child's body could slide between the openings and could become trapped by the head, posing a serious strangulation hazard. Units: 524.

title: CPSC, Planet 3 Announce Recall of Television Stands Sold at Circuit City
summary: The television stand can tip over when a television is placed on it, possibly causing injuries to nearby consumers or death to young children. Units: 3,500.

title: CPSC, Cub Cadet Corp. Announce Recall of Compact Tractors
summary: The tractor's high/low shift lever could pop out of gear into neutral during operation on steep slopes with attachments, such as a back-hoe or front-end loader installed. title: CPSC, Deere & Company Announce Recall of Gator Utility Vehicles
summary: Improper crimping of the brake cables could lead to reduced braking capacity and, in some cases, to failure of the foot pedal brake. Units: 4,600.

title: CPSC, Schylling Associates Inc. Announce Recall of Jack-In-the-Box-Type Toys
summary: The red bead on the crank of the toy can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: 300.

title: CPSC, SecureAlert Announce Recall of Safety and Security Phones
summary: Using the test button can result in the battery being drained without the user's knowledge. Without battery power, the phone is unable to call for assistance in an emergency. Units: 1,000.
